title: pix_opencv_pgh_compare
description: `pix_opencv_pgh_compare` compares contours from an image or video with a pattern contour and outputs the position and dimensions (X, Y, width, and height) of detected contours. Use `criteria` to set the recognition-distance threshold (shown with a default of 0.05), `minsize` to set the minimum contour size, and `bang` to recalculate the pattern contour.
